text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The history and future of Umamusume... and 
the present. Am I really a part of it too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, take a look. Trainer's name is here 
too. Yes, since we've walked this path 
together, it's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It has lots of data, too. ...All I ever do 
is run, though, so I don't really get all 
the complicated stuff.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
With this, the folks back home will have a 
piece of me to hold onto too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, let's do our best. So that I can 
leave plenty of myself behind."
